bug_semantics: Authenticated POST /api/metrics/vis/data in TSVB accepts a JSON body (schema.object({}, {unknowns:'allow'}); visPayloadSchema failures are logged and ignored) and, for a math metric, evaluates attacker-controlled series.metrics[].script on the Node server via mathjs. evaluate.ts does create(all) and exports math.evaluate after only disabling import/createUnit/evaluate/parse/simplify/derivative. Remaining mathjs builtins can mutate Object.prototype from a crafted script/scope, which the advisory treats as prototype pollution enabling RCE. CWE-1321. Closed by deleting the server-side evaluation path.
flaw_origin: The mathjs server sink first appeared in 620624c8443e818e60e73bf927912c25a7c8954b (Replace Tinymath with math.js, #4492, 2023-09-12): it added evaluate.ts and switched series/math.js from tinymath to that wrapper. Parent b9be70ab012d01873ed21d08d9a1c06969068c86 has no evaluate.ts. The evaluate.ts blob is unchanged through 3.0.0 and 3.7.0. 2.19.6 still imports tinymath and is outside the advisory range (>=3.0.0,<3.8.0). Earlier TSVB math (tinymath, 2017-2018) is a different evaluator. #11129 added a client-side path but left the server sink; #12160 removed it.
